Home Owners of Palm Hill, Inc. A Cooperative Association Rules and Regulations Committee Meeting 

August 10, 2026 at 1pm Board Room and Zoom

Agenda 1. Call Meeting to Order 2. Roll Call 3. Approve the agenda for this meeting 4. Approve 5/11/26 meeting minutes 5. Correspondence 6. Announce new members and/or resignations 7. Unfinished Business a. Service Animals/Comfort Animals b. Tree Replacement 8. New Business a. Code of Conduct by Golf Committee b. Registration of Visitors Discuss items for the Committee to review 9. Set next meeting date 10. Motion to Adjourn Questions or Ideas
